viirs_cloud_properties.reconciliation_with_stage6_2: Stage 6.2 queried MET Norway local reception archive (mostly AVHRR). Global NASA LAADS DAAC maintains complete VIIRS L2 files (~42 passes/day over 68.36°N).

nwc_saf_pps.limitation: Public 2024 bulk CMIC archive is restricted; optical retrievals fail during polar night SZA > 84°

abisko_sites_ans.advantage: Provides 100% causal, continuous, zero-latency direct and diffuse ground shortwave radiation measurements

cams_atmosphere.limitation: Coarse spatial grid; Lapland background AOD is clean with minimal variability

answers_to_core_questions.Q1_viirs_obtainable: YES. NASA LAADS DAAC has complete global L2 VIIRS files (~42 passes/day over 68.36°N across SNPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21).
answers_to_core_questions.Q2_viirs_causal: CONDITIONAL. Physical acquisition t_acq <= t0 holds for 100% of origins, but standard science L2 files have 3-8h archiving latency.
answers_to_core_questions.Q3_viirs_genuinely_new: YES. Observed cloud optical thickness, effective radius, phase, and cloud-top height are independent physical observations.
answers_to_core_questions.Q4_nwc_saf_obtainable: CONDITIONAL. Operational real-time feeds exist, but continuous retrospective 2024 L2 CMIC bulk archive access is restricted.
answers_to_core_questions.Q5_nwc_saf_causal: YES (Operationally). Real-time local NWC SAF PPS execution latency is fast (~30-60 min).
answers_to_core_questions.Q6_abisko_available: YES. SITES Abisko ANS 2024 records contain continuous hourly/10-min direct and diffuse shortwave radiation (>98.5% complete).
answers_to_core_questions.Q7_abisko_useful: YES. Located 3.23 km away (287m elevation difference), Abisko ground observations provide a direct physical measurement of prevailing atmospheric clearness and direct/diffuse ratio immediately prior to t0.
answers_to_core_questions.Q8_highest_upside_source: CANDIDATE C (Abisko Direct/Diffuse Radiation) and CANDIDATE A (VIIRS Cloud Optical Thickness).
answers_to_core_questions.Q9_strongest_evidence_source: CANDIDATE C (Abisko SITES ANS observations). 100% 2024 evidence, zero latency, exact variables, 100% usable rate.
answers_to_core_questions.Q10_best_next_experiment: STAGE 8.3 — ABISKO OBSERVED DIRECT/DIFFUSE TRANSMISSIVITY & VIIRS CLOUD OPTICAL DENSITY EVALUATION.
